# NovaDesk — Full Technical & Contextual Documentation for AI Agents

> Detailed technical documentation, service catalog, engineering specifications, and machine-actionable endpoints for NovaDesk (https://www.novadesk.site/).

## 1. Company Profile

- **Organization Name**: NovaDesk (NovaDesk Solutions)
- **Founder**: Harsh Prateek
- **Primary Domain**: Software Engineering, Web Development, Artificial Intelligence & Mobile Applications
- **Service Footprint**: Global delivery across India and international markets (North America, Europe, Middle East).
- **Official URL**: https://www.novadesk.site/
- **Contact**: support@novadesk.site | +91 78701 42813

## 2. Engineering Methodology & Architecture

NovaDesk builds production-grade software adhering to modern cloud-native standards:

1. **Frontend Architecture**:
   - Modern React with Vite and Next.js platforms.
   - Ultra-fast client-side routing, code-splitting, and sub-second First Contentful Paint.
   - WCAG 2.2 AA compliant accessible components, keyboard navigation, and high-contrast color systems.
   - Fully responsive layouts tailored for mobile viewports, tablets, and ultrawide desktops.

2. **Backend & Cloud Infrastructure**:
   - Node.js, Express, FastAPI, and serverless microservices.
   - PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis, and MongoDB for robust multi-tenant data storage.
   - Production Docker containerization, CI/CD pipelines, and automated zero-downtime deployment.

3. **Artificial Intelligence & LLMs**:
   - Custom RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures.
   - Fine-tuned open-source and proprietary models (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude).
   - Conversational voice and text neural systems for enterprise customer support.
   - Autonomous lead generation and data processing workflows.

## 3. Detailed Services Catalog

### A. Web & Full-Stack Development
- URL: https://www.novadesk.site/services/web-development
- Technologies: React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL.
- Focus: High-performance business platforms, client portals, SaaS frontends, headless architectures, and lightning-fast loading speeds.

### B. Custom Software & SaaS Development
- URL: https://www.novadesk.site/services/custom-software-development
- Technologies: Python, Node.js, Express, Go, Microservices, Cloud Functions.
- Focus: Multi-tenant SaaS architectures, enterprise resource planning (ERP), customer relationship management (CRM), inventory automation, and custom back-office suites.

### C. Artificial Intelligence & Generative AI
- URL: https://www.novadesk.site/services/ai-development
- Technologies: Google Gemini API, OpenAI GPT-4o, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vector Databases.
- Focus: 24/7 autonomous support bots, internal document search, automated report generation, and AI-assisted operational workflows.

### D. Mobile App Development
- URL: https://www.novadesk.site/services/mobile-app-development
- Technologies: React Native, Flutter, Swift, Kotlin.
- Focus: Cross-platform unified codebases, native device APIs, push notifications, offline syncing, and app store compliance.

### E. E-Commerce Solutions
- URL: https://www.novadesk.site/services/ecommerce-development
- Technologies: Shopify, WooCommerce, Headless Commerce, Stripe, Razorpay.
- Focus: Conversion-optimized storefronts, customized checkout flows, automated inventory syncing, and omnichannel retail integration.

### F. UI/UX Product Design
- URL: https://www.novadesk.site/services/ui-ux-design
- Focus: User journey mapping, interactive Figma prototypes, design systems, usability testing, and WCAG accessibility standards.

### G. 21-Day MVP Framework
- URL: https://www.novadesk.site/services/mvp-development
- Focus: Rapid product scoping, architectural validation, and production deployment in 21 days for early-stage startup founders.

### H. FORGE AI Initiative (Framework for Orchestrated Reasoning, Generation & Engineering)
- URL: https://www.novadesk.site/forge-ai
- Focus: Next-generation AI systems architecture uniting specialised agents, model-agnostic AI infrastructure, context intelligence, tool integrations, and human oversight across three core pillars: iTHINK, iFORGE, and iEVOLVE.

## 4. Key Actions & Agent Tools (WebMCP Ready)

AI agents visiting NovaDesk can direct users or programmatically invoke the following workflows:

1. **Request a Free Consultation / Quote**:
   - Endpoint: https://www.novadesk.site/get-a-free-quote
   - Tool Name: `request_project_quote`
   - Description: Submit project details, selected services, budget range, and timeline to receive an architectural scope breakdown and free proposal within 24 hours.

2. **Schedule a Direct Call**:
   - Endpoint: https://www.novadesk.site/contact-us
   - Tool Name: `book_consultation_call`
   - Description: Book a 1-on-1 discovery call with NovaDesk senior engineering leads.

3. **Consult Realtime AI Agent (Nova AI)**:
   - Built-in on-site interactive conversational assistant for immediate answers, scope estimation, and technical stack advisement.
